name: stage-1 R_2400 draw 4: remove 300 rows of each of the 8 units at random (2400 rows)
position_rule: each epoch: the retained rows in the shared order of the seed (the full sorted corpus shuffled with derive_seed(seed, 'data-order', epoch), removed rows dropped); the added rows, sorted by id, shuffled with derive_seed(seed, 'added-order', epoch); added row j of m inserted after the floor((j + 1) * n / (m + 1))-th of the n retained rows, so retained rows keep their relative order and added rows are spread evenly

provenance.rule: per unit g in ascending group-id order: s1common.sealed_sample(sorted members of g, 300, registry key random_removal.r2400, d, g); remove = the sorted union (2,400 rows); an independent draw, not nested in R_600 or R_1200
provenance.seed_rule: draw d runs at seed 1100 + d (Gate B's wave rule and the secondary-arm rule)
